remarks:
Welcome home! Lovingly owned by the same family for decades, this charming old style home is now available for you to call home! Fenced back yard providing privacy and for outdoor entertaining or garden space. Stepping in to a covered front porch entry, embrace the light and bright spacious living room and dining room combo space with original hardwood floors! The kitchen provides ample counter space and cabinet storage making it the heart of this home! Three generously sized bedrooms (2 lower and 1 upper) are also host to original hardwoods! The full bath anchors the rear of the 1st floor and the 2 first floor bedrooms finishes off this lower floor living opportunity! Head upstairs and enjoy the large bedroom with walkout porch! The upper level also holds 2 Bonus rooms! Enjoy the backyard which is a blank canvas to use for backyard entertaining or lovely garden space along with a fully fenced in backyard! Freshly painted home throughout, new glass block, newer windows, newer furnace & hot water tank, roof 10yrs young... breathe easy knowing that the big ticket items are updated; so just get ready to move in and enjoy!
Offers if any will be reviewed 9/14 at noon.
